title: DoRChecklist
description: Definition of Ready checklist embedded in every BacklogItem. All gates must be true for the story to pass DoR and enter sprint planning. Mirrors the Go DoRChecklist struct.

problem_clear.description: The problem statement is clear and unambiguous.

testable_ac.description: Acceptance criteria are written in a testable format (Given/When/Then or checklist).

dependencies_surfaced.description: All known dependencies on other stories or systems have been identified and documented.

nfr_flags_set.description: Non-functional requirement flags (performance, security, accessibility) have been evaluated.

passed.description: Aggregate: true when all four gates above are true. Used to filter the Planning Worksheet view.
